If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% in late horizon (days 25–30) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (days 1–10) to counteract pessimism.  
When sentiment swings from positive to negative over 2 consecutive days, shift forecast downward by 2–3% starting from day 15 onward.  
If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and price is trending upward, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast in mid-horizon (days 11–20) to capture momentum.  
If sentiment is neutral and price is trending downward, subtract 0.5–1.0% from forecast in mid-horizon (days 11–20) to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is positive but forecast is below 70% of recent high, increase forecast by 1.0–2.0% in late horizon (days 25–30) to align with sentiment momentum.
